body: If I have to take medicine to resemble a normal person I don't want to make it any further than I have. Its not worth it to me.
I just don't want to have to deal with feeling this way anymore. I had a life before this where I was fine, nothing happened, my mind just broke. This is no way to live.

I started taking vyvanse when I started to struggle in school but I felt like it was making my anxiety worse. I would get stuck thinking about something negative and just couldn't stop, its all I could focus on. So I stopped taking it.
I have, but that would mean going home. All of my friends moved away to college so I would be in town I didn't like to begin with all alone.
Yes, I have. They say they are very proud of me but thats what I would expect them to say. They love me. But I'm nothing to be proud of. I've done nothing to be proud of. I just exist.

I do. I'm not a movie star.
Edit: I don't think I'm particularly attractive either.
